build: Modwerk's linker: the vendored core-ar2 0.7 + this folder's compiled Pipo Loop 0.1.1-experimental, materialised against the owner's stock OS 1.74, --version PP17

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: card images with generated samples (RAMP; RAMP and PIPO_SLOW, a 0.6 s slow sine), JIT on

conditions: SETUP (cold boot on a card holding a generated 0.5 s rising ramp, RAMP.wav, added with dtcard): dtboot pp17.syx --card card.img --instr 14800M --every 1000M --press NO@2000M --press NO@2300M --press NO@2600M --press NO@2900M --press GLOBAL@3300M --press DOWN@5100M --press YES@5400M --press DOWN@5700M --press YES@6000M --press DOWN@6300M --press YES@6600M --press DOWN@6900M --press YES@7200M --press RIGHT@7500M --press DOWN@7800M --press DOWN@8100M --press YES@8400M --press YES@8700M --press NO@10100M --press NO@10300M --press NO@10500M --press NO@10700M --press SMPL@11000M --turn 3:6@11300Mx6/30M --press YES@11700M --turn 6:6@12500Mx6/30M --save setup.snap (BD: SMP 1, LOP ON, SAMPLE page). Each capture then resumes setup.snap. A turn of +8 raw counts is one detent; stock's encoder hysteresis drops the first detents after the setup's turns, so more turns are sent than values. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified. WAVE (for the zero-snap and label captures): the same setup on a card holding RAMP and PIPO_SLOW (28,800 frames, crossings every 2,880 frames), then dtboot pp17.syx --load setup.snap --instr 800M --every 400M --turn 3:8@14900Mx3/80M --press YES@15200M --save a.snap; dtboot pp17.syx --load a.snap --instr 1000M --every 1000M --turn 3:-8@15700Mx4/80M --press YES@16100M --press SMPL@16400M --save wave.snap (BD: SMP PIPO_SLOW, LOP ON, SMPL WAVEFORM). The end frame is DTBOOT_END_PNG.

captures.plan: DTBOOT_TURN_PNG=out dtboot pp17.syx --load setup.snap --instr 1600M --every 400M --press RECORD@14900M --press T1@15100M --press T9@15300M --press T1@15500M:700M --turn 6:8@15560Mx10/50M --press RECORD@16300M
DTBOOT_TURN_PNG=out dtboot pp17.syx --load setup.snap --instr 2000M --every 100M --press SCNE@14900M:900M --press BD@15000M:700M --turn 6:8@15160Mx10/50M

dtboot pp17.syx --load wave.snap --instr 2300M --every 2300M --press RECORD@16650M --press T1@16800M --press T1@17000M:2000M --press FUNC@17050M:1900M --turn 4:16@17150Mx8/150M (trig 1 held: its STA lock 12.00, frame 2880)
